g.data-latex: \begin{align} \vec{p}_{\text{sun}} \text{ (sun position)} &= (x, y, z) \\ \hat{s} \text{ (ray vector)} &= \frac{\vec{o} - \vec{p}_{\text{sun}}}{\|\vec{o} - \vec{p}_{\text{sun}}\|} \end{align} \\ \\ {\small \vec{o} \text{ denotes the global origin}}
